items.title: HP Stock Just Had Its Best Day Since May and Blew Past Wall Street’s Price Target
items.summary: HP's guidance beat consensus by just a few cents, yet buyers piled in while several analysts raised targets and kept their sell ratings. Shrinking cash flow, a thin margin, and a new CEO raise the question of what this price already assumes.

items.title: HP Stock Earnings Beat Has The Bull Case Changed?

The latest results highlight HP's reliance on its Personal Systems segment and AI focused PCs for revenue momentum. items.title: HP (HPQ) Stock May Be 42% Undervalued After Earnings Focus Returns
items.summary: HP Inc. has had a strong year in the market, and that puts a bright spotlight on a simple question for investors who care about cash flows. With the share price moving meaningfully higher in 2026, the issue is whether the current valuation can be supported by the cash the business is expected to generate over time. HP is up 40.8% year to date, which puts recent share price optimism directly up against what its future cash flows can reasonably justify. With quarterly results back in focus...

items.title: HP (HPQ) Brings Marketplace Intelligence Into Multi Jet Fusion Software
items.summary: HP (NYSE: HPQ) announced a new collaboration with Xometry to link its Multi Jet Fusion build optimization tools to Xometry's marketplace. The partnership integrates Xometry's job management and quoting capabilities directly into HP's 3D printing software workflow for production customers. HP plans to use Xometry's marketplace intelligence to inform part costing, material selection and production planning inside Multi Jet Fusion systems.
